clog.text: Ixvi-94 spoke of a dome at the meeting in the habitat: a roof of sky, and streets without suits.
The council has agreed to build a dome. Ixvi-94 spoke for it first, and tonight, in the habitat, Jezero promised to build it together, because its bolder hearts would not wait.
The council still meets most evenings. With the dome agreed, the talk is of smaller things.
